body:
Tested locally, it works as expected.

Note that this PR also adds `underline=never|always|hover` parameter, so you can customize URLs' appearance on a per-URL basis while using BBCode (this was previously only feasible using `push_url()`).

Compared to nesting `[url]` within `[hint]` or the other way around, there is no dashed line on top of the underline. This is a good thing, as you don't want both to be visible at the same time:

![image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/27419cfe-2be7-44f2-8e77-5e7f03d71c6f)

```
[url href="https://example.com" tooltip="Example tooltip"]hello world[/url]

[hint="Example tooltip"][url href="https://example.com"]hello world[/url][/hint]

[url href="https://example.com"][hint="Example tooltip"]hello world[/hint][/url]
```

However, I wonder if the `tooltip` parameter should be `hint` instead, for consistency with the existing `[hint]` tag.
